text:
lee: Heads-up — hitting gp3 IOPS ceiling in eu-west-1 during bulk checkpoint restores for the training fleet. Restores spike concurrent IO and snapshot ops; some instances transiently timeout.

olivia: How wide is the spike? single volume or account-level? any graphs?

lee: Aggregate across 5 volumes per host, fio shows peaks ~9k-11k iops per host for short bursts. Account-level EBS IOPS usage approaching the region quota (we're seeing throttles and 5xx on snapshot create).

kai: Do we have the exact quota error from AWS? copy-paste would help for the support case.

lee: Error from restore logs: `RequestLimitExceeded` and `DependencyViolation` on snapshot-copy during heavy restore. AWS console shows EBS:ProvisionedIOPS quota exceeded and Snapshots:ConcurrentRequests limit reached.

maya: +1 on opening a case. We should request: increase gp3 regional IOPS pool, bump concurrent snapshot ops to 50, and raise ENI limits for the GPU account since attachments spike during rolling restores. Also suggest temporary burst capacity while they process the request.

olivia: I'll open the support ticket. Suggested text for AWS: "Production restore workload causing short, high-intensity IOPS bursts across multiple gp3 volumes; requesting regional EBS IOPS quota increase to 100k and snapshot concurrent operations to 50 in eu-west-1. We also need EC2 ElasticNetworkInterfaces limit increased by 200 for account X to avoid attach failures during parallel restores."

kai: Add target justification: "model checkpoint restores for customer-facing inference clusters; restores are time-sensitive for incident mitigation and backups. We can share CloudWatch graphs and recent event IDs."

olivia: Ticket opened: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234-5678-9012 (AWS case #1234-5678-9012). Submitted metrics + sample CloudWatch export and example fio run.

quota-bot: Created internal tracking: INFRA-4837. Notified aws-quotas on PagerDuty.

lee: Thanks. Can we also loop in accounts@security for the eu account escalation? This touches snapshot permissions for cross-account copy.

maya: Will ping accounts and security. In parallel, let's schedule a short change to shift heavy restores to staggered windows and enable KV-prefix caching to reduce replays. That buys us 24-48h of headroom.

olivia: AWS replied asking for peak 1h and 24h metrics and if we can provide a rollback plan. I'll attach the stagger plan and a list of affected instance IDs.

lee: Pasting sample metrics here for reference:
```
CW: EBSReadOpsAverage (5m): 9,800
CW: EBSWriteOpsAverage (5m): 4,200
Hosts affected: gpu-prod-eu-1a-{12..16}
Snapshot creates per 10m: 18
```

kai: Can we also request increased snapshot copy bandwidth to cross-region (we're often copying to backup account in eu-central)? That would cut time by half.

maya: Good call. Add cross-region snapshot transfer throughput quota + S3 transfer acceleration if needed.

lee: OK, summary action items: olivia — follow up on AWS case with 1h/24h metrics and rollback plan; maya — notify accounts/security and coordinate stagger plan; kai — draft note for S3/DR transfer throughput bump; i'll monitor throttles and post updates.

olivia: Noted. I'll update INFRA-4837 when we get the case greenlight. :thumbsup:

lee: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for follow-ups.
